title: VrPack
description: This modpack contains many features and optimizations!
body:
- Note: This Modpack is recommended to use with vr but you can still use it for normal minecraft.
if you want to disable/delete the vr mods, i list them here:

- -Vivecraft
- -ImmersiveMC
- -MC VR API
  
# **Features**

- -With ImmersiveMc, you can grab a bag (inventory) by holding your left/right hand behind your back
- -with LambDynamicLights - Dynamic Lights, Torches still light the area even if dropped but not if dropped in water
- -Yungs new structures brings makes most structures in minecraft better
- -with Perfect Accuracy you dont miss any shots no more!
- -Sound Physics Remastered and 
- AmbientSounds enhance minecrafts vanilla sounds
- -FreshAnimations brings more details to mobs
- -HT's TreeChop allows you to break trees faster

and the Optimization mods bring you more fps!
you can also add shaders with Iris. I added 3 shaders so you can figure out wich one you like the best.
